positive_cases.name: register_with_action_object
positive_cases.scenario: Script block registering a task built from an action object.
positive_cases.rationale: Both cmdlet and action selections match.

positive_cases.name: register_with_inline_action
positive_cases.scenario: Script block registering a task with an inline action parameter.
positive_cases.rationale: Both cmdlet and action selections match.

negative_cases.name: list_scheduled_tasks
negative_cases.scenario: Script block listing existing scheduled tasks.

negative_cases.name: unregister_task
negative_cases.scenario: Script block removing a scheduled task.
negative_cases.rationale: The registration cmdlet selection does not match a removal cmdlet.

negative_cases.name: comment_mentions_cmdlet
negative_cases.scenario: Script block whose comment names the registration cmdlet.
negative_cases.rationale: The action selection does not match, so the condition fails.

notes: All events are synthetic. Negative cases are deliberate near misses that exercise one failing selection each.
